title: Another channeler also predicted the Challenger disaster

tellings.quote: afterwards I heard from them saying they knew of a another channeler somewhere who had made the same prediction.

plain: Two different channelers, people who say they pass on messages from spirits or other beings, predicted the 1986 Challenger space shuttle disaster, according to the psychologist and paranormal researcher Jeffrey Mishlove. He tells Michels that after the disaster, people at the Foundation for Mind Being Research told him they knew of "another channeler somewhere who had made the same prediction", so this second case is something he heard, not something he saw. If true, two separate predictions of the same event would be hard to put down to chance.
